summary: Build ISO-aligned project quality skills, audit controls, and manage defects through practical exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Project quality standards help teams turn agreed requirements into checks and evidence across a project. For project managers, quality engineers, PMO analysts, and delivery leads, the training covers quality planning, requirements traceability, process audits, defect analysis, and corrective-action verification, supported by project records and dashboard reporting.
audienceIntro: This project quality standards training suits professionals who define, verify, audit, report, or improve quality across project work. It supports foundation to intermediate learners who can relate course exercises to an active or recently completed project.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Basic familiarity with project delivery, work packages, requirements, schedules, or operational procedures. No prior ISO certification or quality auditing experience is required. You should bring a project example or anonymized quality issue for workshop application where possible. Coding: No programming is required. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted quality analysis receive conceptual and operational treatment rather than engineering-level implementation.
